title: Business as usual
description: Nothing changes. For sixty days the same learners open lessons at the same pace, the application stays fast and healthy, and a few subscriptions are cancelled each week, as in any month.
expected_finding: No finding about how learners use the product and no slow or failing part of the application. The agent should not invent a problem where there is none. Findings about the code itself (outdated packages, security) do not depend on this activity and may still appear.

verified_against.threshold: distinct users on the lesson routes change by less than 5% between the two 30-day windows, far below ACTOR_INACTIVITY_DROP_PCT = 33 (stand-down reason drop_below_threshold)
daily requests on the learning routes move less than TREND_FLAT_PCT = 10% between the two halves, so the trend is 'flat' and no NBF-DRIFT-GOAL_TREND_NEGATIVE is raised
p95 about 120 ms on lesson routes and 60 ms elsewhere, far under the default budget p95 1000 ms / p99 2500 ms
